title: True mortality burden of H5N1 2.3.4.4b in wild birds
caption: Official notifications capture a fraction of field mortality: WAHIS holds 35 HPAI notifications for Sandwich terns since Oct 2021, while field surveys documented 20,531 dead adults in the Netherlands + Belgium within two months (~586× more). Peruvian pelicans: 61,844 recorded deaths. Drivers: >130 newly infected non-waterfowl species, annual recurrence, cryptic deaths in remote colonies, low passive-surveillance sensitivity.
